title: fix(app-shell): AI inquiry page review follow-ups — a failed ?c= check, one history read, a no-package notice, previews for listed rows only
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu2jt5vkAJadXv59MofjSkhk)_

Fixes #37908
Fixes #37959

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：应用里的 AI 提问页，网络抖动时不再把用户打开的对话悄悄丢掉回到首页，而是提示「无法打开这个对话」并可重试；打开一个对话只下载一次历史；没有所属软件包的应用会直接说明为什么不能在这里提问；首页「最近对话」最多只为列出的 5 条补读摘要，不再最多补读 20 条。
- 为什么做：上一轮 AI 提问页评审留下的两张跟进卡（会话校验与请求数）。
- 出错会怎样：只影响提问页自己的显示与请求次数，不改数据、不改权限；可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

All in `@object-ui/app-shell` (the AI inquiry page, `AppAskPage.tsx`, and the two hooks it mounts) plus five new `console.ai.askPage` keys in `@object-ui/i18n`.

- **#37908 item 1, a failed `?c=` check is not "foreign".** The check now has a fourth verdict, `failed`, for an answer that is neither the conversation nor a definite 403/404 (a 5xx, a network error). It keeps `?c=` in the address and draws "Couldn't open this conversation" with **Try again** (re-runs the check) and **New conversation**. Only a definite answer (403/404, or another app's conversation) still opens the home state and drops `?c=`.
- **#37908 item 2, as corrected on the card (Premise corrected 7234948699): the history is read once.** There is no metadata-only read to call (see Acceptance notes). When the checked conversation is this app's, the check's own read now hydrates the thread: `useChatConversation` takes `activeRecord`, the host's read of `activeId`, which the first resolve of that id uses instead of fetching it again; any later resolve of that id reads afresh, and a record of another id is ignored.
- **#37908 item 3, an app with no `_packageId`.** The page draws "This app can't keep conversations here" with one sentence of why, instead of a question box that cannot start a conversation.
- **#37908 item 4, duplicate suggestions.** `EmptyConversation` keys suggestions by position and text, so an entry that declares the same question twice draws both, with no React key warning.
- **#37959, previews only for listed rows.** `useConversationList` takes `selectBackfillRows`: the rows the caller shows, the only ones whose missing title or preview is read from the detail route (still at most `MAX_PREVIEW_BACKFILL`, 20). The page's recent conversations pass `recentAskPageConversations`, so the home state reads at most the five rows it lists. The selector is read when the list answers, never as an effect dependency (ui AGENTS.md #10); the page passes `refreshKey: packageId` so a package change re-reads.

## Tests

New top-level `describe`s in the existing harness files (see Acceptance notes for why not a new file):

- `AppAskPage-37788.test.tsx` › "AppAskPage review follow-ups (objectstack#37908)": a 503 check keeps `?c=` and Try again opens the conversation; a dropped network read is `failed`, not foreign; opening this app's `?c=` issues exactly one GET of that conversation; an app with no package draws the notice, no question box and makes no request; a twice-declared suggestion draws twice with no key warning.
- same file › "AppAskPage recent conversations read previews for listed rows only (objectstack#37959)": 16 untitled rows (7 of this app, 6 of another, 3 drawer threads); the detail GETs are exactly the five listed ids.
- `useConversationList.test.tsx` › "useConversationList selectBackfillRows (objectstack#37959)": details are read only for the selected rows, and only those get previews.

## Acceptance notes

- **Item 2's other half waits for the server.** `GET /api/v1/ai/conversations/:id` answers `AiConversationSchema`, whose `messages` is required, and the spec declares no metadata-only query or route; the route is served by `service-ai`, outside this repository. So a `?c=` naming another app's conversation of the same caller is still read once (history included) and dropped. Not filed, per the seat's correction on the card.
- **Tests live in the shared harness file.** The card asks for a new test file named for it; AGENTS.md puts a new pin for a component that already has a shared harness file into that file as a top-level `describe` (ruling record 6583487846), and AGENTS.md wins.
- **A fixture made stale by item 3 (35c1e396).** `AppContent.aiChatEntryGate-37833.test.tsx` lands a member on the `ai:chat` page of an app fixture with no `_packageId`; its two CONTROL cases asserted the home state and now see the no-package notice (Test UI 5/16 red on 3b446639). They ask whether the member landed on the page, so they now assert the page root (`app-ask-page`); the route assertion beside each is unchanged. Giving the fixture a package stamp instead moves the app's route segment and reds eight cases, so that was not taken. That file: 13 passed (13) at 35c1e396.
- A conversation of this app whose hydration read later fails is handled by `useChatConversation` as before; this PR changes only the page's own check.
- Not measured: an app row that reaches the console carrying the `sys_metadata` rehydration sentinel as `_packageId` would bind the page to that value as if it were a package. Read from `package-scoped-resolution.ts` only; no console reading was taken.

## Verification

Two minutes: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/__tests__/AppAskPage-37788.test.tsx`, expect every test to pass, including the five under "review follow-ups (objectstack#37908)".

Read first: `AppAskPage.tsx` (the check effect's `failed` verdict and the `activeRecord` hand-off), then `useChatConversation.ts` (the `activeId` branch that spends `activeRecord` once), then `useConversationList.ts` (`selectBackfillRows`).
